resources.string: The Spotify app is required for playback on this phone. You can still browse your library without it.
This build has no Spotify Client ID. Add SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID to local.properties and rebuild (see README).
Spotineil is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with Spotify. You sign in on Spotify\'s own page — Spotineil never sees your password.
Free music, internet radio, song previews and music on your phone. No account needed.
